name: Regional Government of the Azores
note: Devolved government of the Autonomous Region of the Azores (Portugal). Owns SATA Holding, parent of Azores Airlines: the European Commission's state-aid approval of 7 June 2022 describes the SATA Group as ultimately controlled by the region, and Reuters (8 Sept 2026) confirms the regional government still owns SATA Holding while a privatisation of Azores Airlines (sale of at least 75%) is under way.
